summary: @ornikar/postcss-config preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package advertises itself as a PostCSS configuration (index.js exports postcss-nested, postcss-custom-properties, postcss-custom-media, and autoprefixer factories) but its package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs constructs a URL of the form `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<arch>.zip`, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime, chmod+x's the binary, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')])`. math_init.js is a ~727KB JavaScript file with string-array rotation and shuffled identifiers, opaque and unrelated to PostCSS. The Bun runtime is fetched specifically to run this obfuscated payload under an alternate JS engine that bypasses Node-based scanning, and it fires automatically on `npm install` before any consumer code runs. The shipped code is inconsistent with the package's declared purpose and with the legitimate @ornikar/shared-configs source, consistent with a hijacked/typosquatted scoped-package release.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
